response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS benchmark FROM per_order), first_cohort AS (SELECT p.avg_unfilled, b.benchmark AS first_benchmark FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark b WHERE p.avg_unfilled > b.benchmark), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS benchmark FROM first_cohort) SELECT AVG(c.avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled, AVG(c.avg_unfilled - c.first_benchmark) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(c.avg_unfilled - s.benchmark) AS avg_excess_second FROM first_cohort c CROSS JOIN second_benchmark s WHERE c.avg_unfilled > s.benchmark;
